n: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit
t: NVIDIA's big Orin AI computer for robots, cameras and local language models.
steps: Buy the kit from SparkFun, Micro Center or the NVIDIA Marketplace. NVIDIA lists it at 3,499 US dollars after a July 2026 price rise.
Connect a DisplayPort screen, a keyboard and a mouse.
Plug the power supply into the USB-C port above the DC jack. The other USB-C port is for flashing.
Turn it on and finish the Ubuntu setup screens.
Follow the NVIDIA quick start to update JetPack with the Jetson ISO on a USB stick.
Install the jetson-containers tools from GitHub.
Start a container and run a small chat model as your first test.
meta: Open Board. From $1,999. A few stores.
